name: smalltv-pet
description: A desk pet for Claude Code on a GeekMagic SmallTV Pro: shows what each session is doing and answers permission prompts with the button on top.

deviceUrl.title: Pet address
deviceUrl.description: Where the pet's firmware answers, e.g. http://claude-pet.local or http://192.168.1.50

approvalSeconds.title: Seconds to answer on the pet
approvalSeconds.description: How long a permission prompt waits for the pet's button before the terminal dialog shows. 0 turns desk approvals off.
